description: 2023 NTD Annual Data - General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) Weblinks is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. NOTE: As weblinks are updated continually by transit agencies, some links submitted in Report Year 2023 may no longer work. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 15 columns, among them State, City, TOS, Agency, NTD ID, Agency VOMS. The portal shows 2024-12-16 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
